name: confluence-markdown-mcp
description: Read, write, delete, and organize Confluence Data Center pages via Claude with full storage format (XHTML) and markdown support
author: Jan Vanvinkenroye

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List all Confluence spaces accessible by the authenticated user

tools.name: list_recent_pages
tools.description: List Confluence pages recently modified by the authenticated user

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search Confluence pages via CQL expression or free-text query

tools.name: list_children
tools.description: List direct child pages of a given Confluence page

tools.name: get_page_storage
tools.description: Get page content in Confluence storage format (XHTML) — preserves tables, macros, layouts losslessly

tools.name: get_page_md
tools.description: Get page content converted to Markdown

tools.name: create_page_storage
tools.description: Create a new Confluence page with storage format (XHTML) content

tools.name: create_page_md
tools.description: Create a new Confluence page with Markdown content

tools.name: edit_page_storage
tools.description: Replace page content with storage format (XHTML)

tools.name: add_content_storage
tools.description: Append or prepend storage format (XHTML) content to a page

tools.name: add_content_md
tools.description: Append or prepend Markdown content to a page

tools.name: check_elicitation_support
tools.description: Check whether the connected MCP client supports human-in-the-loop confirmation

tools.name: move_page
tools.description: Move a page to a new parent (change its position in the hierarchy)

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Delete a page (move it to trash)

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List the attachments of a page (filename, size, media type, version, download URL)

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Download an attachment from a page to a local file

tools.name: upload_attachment
tools.description: Upload a local file as an attachment to a page (same filename creates a new version)

resources.description: Read a Confluence page as Markdown
Read a Confluence page in storage format (XHTML) — lossless

authentication.instructions: Save your Confluence credentials using: confluence-markdown --base-url https://your-confluence.com --username YOUR_USERNAME --token YOUR_PAT --save-config --action test-auth
